name: quick_talk_right_away
description: Just talk: they start talking 0.8 s after the Table starts listening, so no icebreaker ever goes out. The 20 s warm-up runs from go-live; the first pause after it gets a steer 3 s after the last turn.

turns.text: Hi, sorry, is this seat taken or can I sit here for a bit?
Go for it, I'm just waiting for the talk to start in a few minutes.
Oh nice, which one? I came for the one about city bike lanes.
Same one, I bike to campus every day so I have a lot of opinions.
Okay now I need to hear the opinions, what is the worst street for it?
Guadalupe, easily, the bus lane ends and suddenly you are in traffic.
